Topology tile execution, sandboxing, stack setup, and XDP install helpers.

# Purpose
This file contains the runtime support for starting and managing topology tiles in separate threads or in a single process. It sets up thread names, logging, CPU affinity, priorities, stack memory, and optional debugger waits before a tile enters its run loop. It also handles sandbox entry, user and group switching, file descriptor allow lists, seccomp filters, and resource limits, then joins tile workspaces and registers tile metrics before calling the tile-specific `run` function.

The file also provides support functions for tile stack allocation and XDP installation. [`fd_topo_tile_stack_join`](<#fd_topo_tile_stack_join>) maps a private stack with guard pages, and [`fd_topo_install_xdp`](<#fd_topo_install_xdp>) installs an XDP program for the `net` tile and keeps the returned file descriptors at fixed numbers. The [`fd_topo_run_single_process`](<#fd_topo_run_single_process>) function starts all selected tiles in the current process, waits until each thread has copied its startup state, and then restores the original CPU affinity and priority after tile startup completes.
